CommunityApplications.Profile: Unraid Community Applications templates and one-click wrapper images for self-hosted tools, maintained by Hardskiller. Wrapper images stay as close to the upstream project as possible: the official image plus the minimum needed to make it install cleanly on Unraid (for example generating a required secret on first start). Builds follow upstream stable releases automatically. Template and image support via GitHub Issues; application questions belong to the upstream project linked in each template.
